# Browser Manifest V3 — manifest.json, Service Worker, Content Scripts

## manifest.json (Generated by Webpack)

```json
{
  "manifest_version": 3,
  "name": "Omni",
  "version": "0.0.1",
  "description": "Omni Browser Extension",
  "permissions": ["activeTab", "scripting", "storage"],
  "host_permissions": ["<all_urls>"],
  "background": {
    "service_worker": "background.js",
    "type": "module"
  },
  "content_scripts": [{
    "matches": ["<all_urls>"],
    "js": ["content.js"],
    "run_at": "document_idle"
  }],
  "action": {
    "default_popup": "popup.html",
    "default_title": "Omni"
  },
  "options_page": "options.html",
  "web_accessible_resources": [{
    "resources": ["*.png", "*.svg"],
    "matches": ["<all_urls>"]
  }]
}
```

## Entry Points (Webpack)

| Entry | Output | Purpose |
|-------|--------|---------|
| `src/apps/background/index.ts` | `background.js` | Service worker (MV3) |
| `src/apps/content/index.ts` | `content.js` | Injected into pages |
| `src/apps/popup/index.tsx` | `popup.html` + `popup.js` | Extension popup |
| `src/apps/options/index.tsx` | `options.html` + `options.js` | Options page |

## Service Worker (Background)

```typescript
// src/apps/background/index.ts
chrome.runtime.onInstalled.addListener(() => {
  console.log("Omni installed");
});

chrome.action.onClicked.addListener((tab) => {
  // Opens popup automatically via manifest
});

chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((msg, sender, sendResponse) => {
  // Handle messages from content/popup
  return true; // async response
});
```

## Content Script

```typescript
// src/apps/content/index.ts
console.log("Omni content script loaded");

// Communicate with background
chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ type: "PING" }, (response) => {
  console.log("Background responded:", response);
});

// Inject UI if needed
const container = document.createElement("div");
container.id = "omni-overlay";
document.body.appendChild(container);
```

## Messaging Pattern

```typescript
// Type-safe messaging
interface Message {
  type: string;
  payload?: unknown;
}

function sendMessage<T>(msg: Message): Promise<T> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage(msg, resolve as (response: T) => void);
  });
}

// Usage
const result = await sendMessage<{ data: string }>({ type: "GET_DATA" });
```

## Build

```bash
# Development (watch)
pnpm dev

# Production
pnpm build
# Output: dist/ (v2 and v3 folders for Chrome/Firefox)
```

## Manifest V2 vs V3

| Feature | V2 | V3 (Current) |
|---------|-----|--------------|
| Background | Persistent page | Service worker |
| Content scripts | `content_scripts` | Same |
| Popup | `browser_action` | `action` |
| Options | `options_page` | Same |
| Web accessible | `web_accessible_resources` | Array with `matches` |
| Script execution | `<script>` | ES modules (`type: "module"`) |

## Firefox

Webpack outputs `dist/v2/` (Manifest V2) for Firefox and `dist/v3/` (Manifest V3) for Chrome. Firefox MV3 support is rolling out; V2 still accepted on AMO.
